name: Sweet Potato Pizza with Prosciutto, Olives & Green Peppers

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position the rack in the upper third of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.36 kg sweet potatoes
1 ½ green bell peppers
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Peel and coarsely grate the sweet potatoes.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
When the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add sweet potatoes, garlic, salt, and pepper to the skillet and fry, stirring occasionally, until softened, 5-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and thinly slice the onion into rounds.

Transfer the sweet potatoes to a baking dish. Using the back of a spoon, press the sweet potato mixture into an even layer. Place baking dish in the oven and broil until starting to brown 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, seed and thinly slice the peppers into rounds. Thinly slice olives.
Remove baking dish from the oven and top with tomato sauce, oregano, cheese, veggies, and prosciutto.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (213 ml) cans tomato sauce
1 ½ tsp oregano
15 slices prosciutto

instructions.primary_message: Return baking dish to the oven and broil until the cheese is melted and golden, about 5 minutes. (The sweet potato crust will remain soft, enjoy this pizza with a fork and knife.)
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Remove baking dish from the oven and garnish with fresh basil and crushed red pepper. Divide between plates and enjoy!
